text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Neo Universe 
ran relentlessly without pause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if shaking off something clinging to 
her. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM, SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... The "satellite's" gravitational 
interference is severe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, the waves are... 
"raging."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's looking a bit rough today.
Yeah, it feels pretty turbulent today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During break time, she often gazed 
steadily at the ocean, as if drawn to it 
by something. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, everyone, over here, over here! The 
waves are super high♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A group of four arrived. Umamusume from 
the generation just above Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! How would all of you conquer 
these rough waves?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Rough seas...? "Overcome" them, 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Alongside the Umamusume who competed at 
the Takarazuka Kinen, the noble Fine 
Motion and the King of Destruction, Tanino 
Gimlet, were also present."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Rough seas herald the dawn. If the 
sea god roars and the ocean turns 
tempestuous—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to kick it down! 
Shatter! Scatter into white! I'll embrace 
Benthesikyme in my left arm!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Facing the rough waves, huh... The method 
is simple.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Simply moving forward through the 
waves—with an unyielding will.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd prepare a boat. Maybe 
charter one nearby♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. Kicking it away, pushing through, 
or borrowing it— they all sound pretty 
tough~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll just catch the wave on its way 
back. Hehehe..."

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: ...What!? —I see. ...I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own way of navigating 
rough seas. Hearing that, Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""MAZY", right? Whichever method... It can 
resist the tidal forces."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I can overcome the waves. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The sea itself—cannot be crossed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the ocean and venturing to what 
lies "beyond"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe gazed quietly far beyond the 
rough waves... toward the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—That night, as the two of us walked 
along the seashore..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Even if you can ride the waves, 
you cannot overcome the sea. If so—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To meet "people" across the sea— what kind 
of "mentality" is required?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To meet people across the sea. The 
mentality needed for that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I do not quite understand the motive 
behind your question. However, what is 
necessary to meet someone far away is...
choice_data_list: The initiative to go see them in person

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Having the drive to go meet them... 
That's 'PERS' for you, yeah...?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yet Neo Universe is "alienated." Because 
there are "checkpoints" along every route.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... To Neo Universe, you see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Patience in waiting... Refraining from 
'rushing over' instantly...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The boundary between "passive" and 
"active" cannot be discerned by Neo 
Universe. However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... To Neo Universe, you see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I have a vision. —A vision of "The 
Arrival."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If it is truly "QOAX"— they will 
come.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yet I am the only "me" who has the 
visions. Without the visions, one cannot 
see the "orbit."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If the “doors of summer” don't open, you 
won't get to see autumn...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe observes. Can be observed. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... will you "come"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I don't yet know the color of the sea or 
the shape of the waves. Because the 
causality of the "swell" is always 
shifting.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Do you still wish for it to "come"? Or 
will you, here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two eyes like ice look straight at me... 
as if peering into the bottom of a lake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I decided to stop overthinking it. I'll 
let the deepest nuances sink straight into 
my brain."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was my way of contacting Neo 
Universe. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: I'll go. I wish to go.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes... ...Sfera.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira. However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe assumes "The Great Dividing."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't come, it simply 
"reveals" the truth. "Severance" is... a 
rebirth, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think I understand what she meant. I 
pledged to the night sea that I would walk 
alongside Neo Universe to the very ends of 
the earth.
